evidence.observation: Exodus says Moses was afraid when his killing became known, and he fled after Pharaoh sought to kill him.
Hebrews says Moses left Egypt by faith without fearing the wrath of the king.

record.tension: Exodus places Moses’ fear immediately before his flight from Pharaoh, while Hebrews describes his departure from Egypt without fear of the king’s wrath.
record.title: Did Moses leave Egypt in fear?
